premise.background: A hillside watchtower has gone dark three nights before the winter caravan arrives.
premise.hook: The village Reeve asks the party to ride up the ridge and relight the beacon.

locations.name: Ridge Watchtower
locations.summary: A stone signal tower overlooking the valley road.

actors.name: Reeve Tomas
actors.summary: The worried village official who hires the party.

scenes.title: The Cold Beacon
scenes.summary: The party reaches the top of the tower and finds the oil brazier unlit.

endings.title: Beacon Relit
endings.description: The signal fire burns again and the winter caravan safely navigates the pass.
